args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Created: May 15, 2024
Trip Dates: June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Power adapter (if needed)
- Medications and prescriptions
- First aid kit

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and shopping
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes or reef walkers for snorkeling
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes for Diamond Head
- Flip flops or sandals
- Hat with wide brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+ minimum)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof watch

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking gear for Diamond Head
- Backpack or day pack
- Water bottle or hydration system
- Trail snacks
- Insect repellent
- Quick-dry clothing

EVENING ACTIVITIES:
- Luau-appropriate attire (aloha shirts, floral dresses)
- Semi-casual outfit for nicer dinners
- Jewelry or accessories (minimal)

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if desired)
- Contact lenses and solution (if needed)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader for beach relaxation
- Travel pillow for flights
- Earplugs and eye mask
- Reusable water bottle
- Small backpack for day trips
- Ziplock bags for wet items
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach toys, cooler for drinks
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera, waterproof bag
- June 13 (Diamond Head hiking): Trekking poles, energy bars
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Car snacks, playlist downloaded
- June 16 (Luau): Floral shirt/dress, small gift for hosts (optional)
- June 17 (Spa day): Swimsuit, flip flops
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Quick-dry clothes, waterproof bag
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags, comfortable shoes
